Point-by-point response: agreed that validation-after-normalization was the real gap and moved all indexed fact validation to raw persisted buckets; covered blank/whitespace concepts, malformed values/languages/provenance/non-object facts and non-array buckets; preserved source indices; proved raw Markdown/SQLite round-trip, readiness and publish rejection, projector filtering, and meaningful-phrase validity. Stage 1 found every rework3 objective covered with no Port/vector/query changes. Stage 2 found no blocker/high/medium issue; reviewed deterministic ordering, diagnostic overlap, linear complexity, pending/staging compatibility, invalid projection filtering, and clean scope.

The recurring failure was architectural ordering, not an incomplete placeholder token set: normalizeFacts was a lossy projector helper but readiness treated its output as authored truth. Empty facts disappeared and later fact indices shifted before validation. The fix separates boundaries: raw persisted profile is the validation authority; normalized profile is only deterministic hash/projection material.
